title: flotilla
summary: A small platform for agent fleets: flotillad (Go) schedules routines, keeps cases, the ledger and the operator UI, and dispatches each run to a worker (Python, in Docker, on the host or a remote machine). The fleets: triage (alerts and errors to GitHub issues), bugfix (an issue to a draft fix), ops (backups and host checks), SEO, and platform checks.
notes: Rules for coding agents are in AGENTS.md (CLAUDE.md imports it); bugfix-fleet/AGENTS.md is scoped to that folder. Decisions are ADRs under docs/adr/ and proposals RFCs under docs/rfc/; how the system fits together is docs/architecture/; how to run each fleet is docs/operations/. Each routine is a spec in fleets/<fleet>/<routine>.yaml.
This file is generated by scripts/llms_txt.py from llms.config.json; `make llms-txt` rewrites it and `make lint` (CI) fails when it is stale.
